# Example NyBoot theme: light. A plain GRUB 2 theme; copy the folder with
#   nyforge boot theme <drive> docs/themes/light
# Every .pf2 font in this folder is loaded for you. Fonts are named "<family> <style> <size>".

title-text: ""
desktop-color: "#e9ecf1"

terminal-font: "GNU Unifont Regular 16"
terminal-left: "10%"
terminal-top: "10%"
terminal-width: "80%"
terminal-height: "80%"
terminal-border: "0"
terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"

+ label {
    id = "keys"
    left = 24
    top = 100%-52
    width = 70%
    height = 24
    text = "↑ ↓  Choose     Enter  Start     E  Edit     C  Command line"
    font = "Liberation Sans Regular 15"
    color = "#5b6578"
    align = "left"
}

+ boot_menu {
    left = 15%
    top = 12%
    width = 70%
    height = 76%
    item_font = "Liberation Sans Regular 24"
    selected_item_font = "Liberation Sans Bold 24"
    item_color = "#2a3140"
    selected_item_color = "#0d1b33"
    icon_width = 0
    icon_height = 0
    item_icon_space = 0
    item_height = 46
    item_padding = 12
    item_spacing = 2
    menu_pixmap_style = "menu_*.png"
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    scrollbar = true
    scrollbar_width = 6
    scrollbar_thumb = "scrollbar_thumb_*.png"
    scrollbar_frame = "scrollbar_frame_*.png"
}

+ label {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 0
    top = 90%
    width = 100%
    height = 24
    text = "Starting automatically in %d seconds"
    font = "Liberation Sans Regular 17"
    color = "#5b6578"
    align = "center"
}
